# lakekeeper_column_tag (Resource)

The `lakekeeper_column_tag` resource attaches a governance tag to a Lakekeeper table column.

~> **Preview:** Governance tags are a **preview** feature in Lakekeeper and may change in future releases.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/tag/operation/set_table_column_tag)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lakekeeper_column_tag" "email_pii" {
  warehouse_id = "261bd4e4-5c57-4707-96ad-44128f9038c0"
  table_id     = "37cf8760-5092-4d5d-8b29-a6b46a45f067"
  column_name  = "email"
  tag_name     = "pii"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `column_name` (String) The name of the column. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `table_id` (String) The UUID of the table. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `tag_name` (String) The name of the tag definition to attach. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
- `warehouse_id` (String) The UUID of the warehouse. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `value` (String) The tag value. Required for `free-text` and `enumerated` tag definitions; must be omitted for `marker` tag definitions.

### Read-Only

- `applied_at` (String) Timestamp when the tag was applied or last updated.
- `id` (String) The ID of the tag attachment, in the form `{{warehouse_id}}/{{table_id}}/{{column_name}}/{{tag_name}}`.
- `tag_definition_id` (String) The UUID of the attached tag definition.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# id is "{{warehouse_id}}/{{table_id}}/{{column_name}}/{{tag_name}}"
terraform import lakekeeper_column_tag.email_pii "261bd4e4-5c57-4707-96ad-44128f9038c0/37cf8760-5092-4d5d-8b29-a6b46a45f067/email/pii"
```
